{{Quote|So Master Yoda sent me to Hurikane, far beyond the Outer Rim. It was my first solo mission and I knew I would succeed.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Stones">{{Tales|13|Stones}}</ref>}}
In approximately [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] embarked on a '''mission''' to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hurikane]]. The Padawan had been assigned the mission by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] so that he could obtain the unique [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] he desired to build his [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. On Hurikane, Windu encountered a [[Stone/Legends|rock-encrusted]] [[Unidentified Hurikane species|indigenous humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and engaged in conflict with them, which resulted in [[Unidentified Hurikane native|one]] of the natives falling into a ravine and shattering his body. Filled with regret, Windu used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force healing|heal]] the native's body. In gratitude, the natives gave the Padawan [[Color/Legends|violet]] [[Hurrikaine crystal]]s, which he used to construct his lightsaber.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Jedi Council suggested I was afraid. But I was just looking for the right challenge&hellip; crystals that would make my lightsaber unique.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Stones" />}}
In approximately [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]], during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]],<ref name="Date" /> the fourteen-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old<ref name="Stones" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Korun/Legends|Korun]]<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was top of his class but had not yet built his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="Stones" /> although he had first conceived its design at the age of nine.<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> His [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] were concerned, believing that Windu was afraid, while the Padawan himself wanted a suitable challenge in finding unique [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. To that end, Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] sent Windu on his first solo mission to<ref name="Stones" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Insider 70">{{InsiderCite|70|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> [[Hurikane]],<ref name="Stones" /> in the [[Hurikane system/Legends|eponymous system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==The mission==
{{Quote|The self-control came easily. Responsibility was&hellip; much more difficult to master. It required that I admit to misdjudging my opponents&hellip; and then resolve to repair the damage done.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Stones" />}}
[[File:MaceHurikane.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Windu uses the Force to heal the Hurikane native's body.]]
On the world's [[Stone/Legends|rocky]] terrain, Windu was surrounded by several members of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Unidentified Hurikane species|rock-encrusted species]] indigenous to Hurikane. The young Jedi, however, was confident in his intelligence, use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and his speed. Two of the natives lunged at Windu; he jumped upward to avoid them and threw one of them against a rock wall. As two more of the natives charged toward him, the Padawan discarded his [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] and used them to cover one of the humanoid's faces.<ref name="Stones" /> 

He then used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] a pile of stones to block the natives before leaping to the other side of a ravine. One of the [[Unidentified Hurikane native|pursuing natives]] consequently fell into the ravine and shattered<ref name="Stones" /> his<ref name="CSWE Hurikane">{{CSWECite|II|68|Hurikane}}</ref> rocky body. This distressed both the other natives, who howled into the air, and Windu,<ref name="Stones" /> who was ashamed of himself<ref name="CSWE Hurikane" /> and reflected that he had misdjuged his opponents. Choosing to make restitution, Windu descended into the ravine next to the native and offered his assistance.<ref name="Stones" /> The Padawan drew deeply from the Force<ref name="CSWE Hurikane" /> and [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] the rocky individual by reassembling pieces of his body, relieving the native and his companions, who offered Windu several [[Color/Legends|violet]] [[Hurrikaine crystal]]s in gratitude.<ref name="Stones" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|On Hurikane, I became a Jedi Knight in spirit, if not in title. And the rewards were great.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Stones" />}}
[[File:MaceWinduLightsaber-SWCT.png|thumb|left|200px|Mace Windu built a purple-bladed lightsaber with the crystals he received on Hurikane.]]
Windu would later reflect on how his mission had taught him the essential qualities of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], such as confidence, self-awareness, commitment, selflessness, and humility,<ref name="Stones" /> along with lessons about control and the nature of the Force.<ref name="Starships">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|25|Welcome On Board}}</ref> He used the Hurrikaine crystals to build his own [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which had a distinctive purple hue,<ref name="Weapons">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> although he constructed a [[Mace Windu's blue-bladed lightsaber|blue-bladed lightsaber]] first.<ref name="Fact File 112">{{FactFile|112|LIG 19-20|Mace Windu's Lightsabers}}</ref> Windu's reputation grew to the point that he was regarded as one of the greatest Jedi of his era,<ref name="Starships" /> and his lightsaber was perceived as one of the deadliest objects in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Fact File 112" /> The story of Windu's first mission spread<ref name="CSWE Windu">{{CSWECite|III|331|Windu, Mace}}</ref> into legend<ref name="Annual 2014">''[[Star Wars Annual 2014]]''</ref> and was shared by others, along with several of his other exploits.<ref name="CSWE Windu" /> Windu at one point recounted the story of his mission to a class of Jedi [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] before they were to construct their own lightsabers.<ref name="Stones" /> The Jedi used his purple-bladed lightsaber up until his [[Showdown on Coruscant|death]] at the hands of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Star_Wars_-_Tales_13.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The mission to Hurikane first appeared in ''Star Wars Tales'' 13 (cover pictured).]]
The mission to Hurikane appeared in "[[Stones]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[W. Haden Blackman]], pencilled by [[Michael Zulli]], and published in the Mace Windu-centered [[Star Wars Tales 13|thirteenth issue]] of the anthology series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'',<ref name="Stones" /> on [[September 25]], [[2002]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/11-898/Star-Wars-Tales-13|text=Star Wars Tales #13}}</ref> The comic serves as an explanation for how Windu acquired his unique purple-bladed lightsaber,<ref name="Insider 70" /> previously introduced in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> which premiered on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year By Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

The novel [[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']] by [[Matthew Stover]], published on [[June 3]], 2003,<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=30059|text=Matthew Woodring Stover}}</ref> offers conflicting details regarding the timing of the construction of Windu's lightsaber, and therefore the dating of the mission. The novel states that a nine-year-old Windu first imagined the shape of his lightsaber forty-one years prior to its events, and that he had constructed it three years after his first conception of it.<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> Given the novel's placement in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> this suggests that Windu first conceived of his lightsaber in [[63 BBY]] and built it in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], when he was twelve years old, conflicting with his age of fourteen at the time of the mission in "Stones,"<ref name="Stones" /> which would place the mission in approximately 58 BBY.<ref name="Date" /> This article follows the dates suggested by "Stones."

In the [[Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A]] section of the [[Star Wars Insider 70|seventieth issue]] of [[Star Wars Insider|''Star Wars Insider'']]<ref name="Insider 70" />&mdash;first shipped to subscribers on [[August 15]], 2003<ref name="SW.com 70">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20030812.html|text=Darth Maul reveals all in ''Insider'' #70}}</ref>&mdash;author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] stated that the events of "Stones" were only a possible explanation for how Windu acquired his purple lightsaber crystal, or that his mission to Hurikane was a myth entirely, due to the ambiguous [[Canon|canonicity]] of ''Star Wars Tales''.<ref name="Insider 70" /> In the later Q&A section of the [[Star Wars Insider 72|seventy-second issue]],<ref name="Insider 72">{{InsiderCite|72|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> shipped to subscribers on [[November 14]], 2003,<ref name="SW.com 72">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/11/news20031105.html|text=Obi-Wan Exposed in ''Insider'' #72}}</ref> Hidalgo indicated that the events of "Stones" were likely non-canon, as other sources had depicted Windu wielding a blue-bladed lightsaber prior to the introduction of his purple lightsaber in ''Attack of the Clones'', while "Stones" suggests that he had used a purple lightsaber since his youth.<ref name="Insider 72" /> The [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 112|one-hundred and twelfth issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'', published by [[De Agostini]] on [[February 18]], [[2004]],<ref name="112 Date">{{FFdates|112}}</ref> then clarified that Windu's blue lightsaber was his first, while still stating that Windu had collected his purple lightsaber crystals on one of his first solo missions.<ref name="Fact File 112">{{FactFile|112|LIG 19-20|Mace Windu's Lightsabers}}</ref>
